text:
anya: Quick RFC follow-up: need a practical settlement API for invoice windows that handles late arrivals cleanly.
miguel: Customers want stable invoice numbers; ingest emits per-event tokens and occasionally re-attributes after fixes. How do we surface adjustments?
sam: Two patterns: (1) settlement per-window + adjustments feed, or (2) raw-event stream and customers build windows. (1) is easier for accounting.
julia: Agreed, go with settlement + adjustments. But adjustments must be append-only and clearly reference original event ids and reasons.
kevin: Adjustment types: CORRECTION, SPLIT, MERGE, REVERSAL, BACKFILL. Each adjustment must include adj_id, related_event_ids, delta_tokens, delta_amount_cents, reason, prov_ptrs, created_by, created_ts.
metering-bot: note: staging conflict rate (event_id mismatches) ~0.02% last 30d. Surface these to ingest team.
anya: API response shape suggestion: {start, end, status: PROVISIONAL|FINAL, net_tokens, net_amount_cents, adjustment_summary, adjustments_stream_url}. Include first page of adjustments inline.
miguel: Finality model: provisional -> locked -> final. Default provisional TTL 72h, tenant-configurable up to 30d. After FINAL, only explicit adjustments allowed and visible.
sam: Implementation: use event_id diffs (not recalc floats). Store canonical event_id -> fingerprint mapping; finalizer computes incremental deltas.
julia: UX: invoices should show original line items plus appended adjustment rows and a human-readable reason (<=280 chars). Provide CSV/Parquet export for audits.
kevin: Provenance pointers format: ledger://region/stream/offset. Retain raw provenance 90 days by default; enterprise configurable. Adjustments and settlements retained indefinitely.
anya: Performance notes: adjustments_stream pagination must be cursor-based; first page <= 300ms. Provide grouped/rolled-up view for noisy backfills.
metering-bot: ACTION: emit daily conflict summary to #eng-platform; trigger pager if sustained >0.1%.
anya: Action items: event schema draft (sam+miguel) due Wed COB; finality config RFC (product+infra); adjustments stream spec (anya+eng-platform) spike this week; ingest idempotency alerting (ingest). I'll draft RFC and tag reviewers.
